description: A module-level assignment replaces an imported callable before a wrapper uses it.

expected_affected.tests/test_price.py::test_price: Calls core.price directly and reads its changed return.

expected_unaffected.tests/test_control.py::test_control: Calls only unchanged control.healthy in an independent subsystem.
expected_unaffected.tests/test_worker.py::test_read: worker replaces price with a constant-return lambda; the wrapper no longer calls core.price.

false_positives.tests/test_worker.py::test_read: Module assignment is not tracked, so the stale import alias produces a spurious resolved-call path.

limitations: Module-level rebinding can leave stale import aliases. Even evidence labeled resolved is static inference, not proof of runtime dispatch.
